prompt:

Preserve its apparent front-three-quarter viewing direction and proportions. Isolate that ONE Sheep on a plain near-white background, centered with generous breathing room in a square image. REMOVE every other animal, all headings/labels/text/numbers, all axes/arrows/grids/pivot markers/guides, ground tiles and all scenery. Remove the drawn ground-grid marks under its feet. Retain calm painterly cream/ochre colors, anatomically credible quadruped, strong readable wool masses. No watermark, no collage, no cut-off feet, no circular pedestal, no photorealistic replacement, no extra content. This is a single-subject modeling INPUT reference, not a calibrated turnaround or game-ready sprite.
